user.title: daytime SC20
user.description: Enter the address of your SC20 controller. It needs no username or password — the device has no authentication at all, so anyone on your network can control it.

data_description.host: The IP address or hostname of the controller, for example 192.168.1.34 or sc20.local

error.cannot_connect: No SC20 answered at that address. Check that it is powered on and on the same network.

abort.already_configured: This controller is already set up

init.title: daytime SC20
init.description: These pages follow the controller's own web interface. Everything except Connection is stored on the lamp itself, not in Home Assistant.

daycycle.title: Daycycle

data_description.sunrise: How long the light takes to reach full brightness after the day starts.
data_description.sunset: How long the light takes to fade out before the day ends.
data_description.individual: When off, the single brightness above governs all three channels and the per-colour values are ignored.

moonlight.title: Moonlight
moonlight.description: Night lighting between the two times below. The window may run past midnight — an end earlier than the start is normal.

data_description.lunar_cycle: When off, every night uses the full-moon brightness. When on, brightness rises and falls over a 30-day cycle.
data_description.color: Which channels carry the moonlight. At least one is required.

clouds.title: Cloud simulation
clouds.description: Random dimming through the day, as passing clouds.

data_description.min_level: How much a cloud dims the light. 0 % is no dimming at all; 100 % is fully dark.
data_description.probability: The chance that each scheduled cloud actually appears. 100 % means every one does.

acclimatisation.title: Acclimatisation
acclimatisation.description:
Gradually raises the light over the first weeks of a new tank, starting reduced and easing to full.

The controller is currently on day {current_day}.

data_description.reduction: How far the light is held below the programme on the first day.

connection.title: Connection
connection.description: The only setting here that is stored in Home Assistant rather than on the lamp.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to read the live light levels. The controller is a small device with little memory — short intervals track cloud simulation more closely but load it harder.

error.cannot_connect: The controller did not accept the change. It may have gone offline.
error.invalid_daycycle: Those times do not make a workable day. The sunrise and sunset durations together must fit between the start and end times.
error.min_above_max: The minimum cannot be greater than the maximum.

abort.not_loaded: The integration is not loaded. Reload it and try again.
abort.no_data: These settings have not been read from the controller yet. Try again in a moment.

set_daycycle.name: Set daycycle
set_daycycle.description: Replace the lighting programme. The previous programme is backed up first, because the controller has no undo.

setpoints.name: Setpoints
setpoints.description: A list of [minute, white, blue, red] rows. Minute is 0-1440 from midnight, the levels are percentages. Up to 30 rows, sorted by time, starting at minute 0 and ending at minute 1440.

get_daycycle.name: Get daycycle
get_daycycle.description: Read the current lighting programme, both as a list of setpoints and as the contents of a .scen file.

load_scenario.name: Load scenario file
load_scenario.description: Upload a .scen scenario file as the lighting programme. The previous programme is backed up first.

filename.name: File
filename.description: Path to the .scen file. It must be inside a directory Home Assistant is allowed to read.

save_scenario.name: Save scenario file
save_scenario.description: Write the current lighting programme to a .scen file, in the same format the vendor app uses.

filename.name: File
filename.description: Where to write the .scen file. It must be inside a directory Home Assistant is allowed to write.

preview_curve.name: Preview daycycle
preview_curve.description: Play the stored programme back at speed as a demonstration. Set the mode back to Daycycle to stop it.

config_entry_id.name: Controller
config_entry_id.description: Which SC20 to run the preview on.

speed_factor.name: Speed
speed_factor.description: How much faster than real time to play. 100 runs a whole day in about fifteen minutes.

start_time.name: Start
start_time.description: Minute of the day to start from.

end_time.name: End
end_time.description: Minute of the day to stop at.

set_clock.name: Sync clock
set_clock.description: Set the controller's clock from Home Assistant's local time. The schedule runs off this clock, so drift shifts your whole lighting day.
